responsibility: This file implements emission of BPF Compile Once – Run Everywhere metadata into the .BTF.ext section. It owns the in-memory representation of CO-RE relocation records grouped by ELF section, builds access strings and container type IDs from GCC/CTF/BTF type information, records instruction labels to be patched, computes member indexes for struct/union fields, initializes the .BTF.ext output section, and finally writes the BTF.ext header and per-section relocation records consumed by CO-RE-capable BPF loaders.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-stem coreout file, this is the implementation that builds and emits CO-RE relocation data into .BTF.ext, maintaining relocation/section state and writing serialized records. Its sibling coreout.h only defines the public record layouts, relocation-kind enum, and function declarations used by the rest of the BPF backend.
